username.label: AniDB Username
username.description: Your AniDB account username (NOT the API password). Registration is free.

api_key.label: AniDB UDP API Key
api_key.description: The UDP "API Key" (a.k.a. API password) you set in your AniDB profile under Settings → Account → API. This is SEPARATE from your website login password.

use_title_dump.label: Use AniDB Title Dump
use_title_dump.description: Download the daily anime titles dump for fast, offline search. Recommended — it greatly reduces rate-limited API calls.

title_dump_url.label: Title Dump URL
title_dump_url.description: Source URL for the anime-titles.dat.gz file. Optional — change only if using a mirror. Must be https: AniDB is behind Cloudflare, which answers the plain-http URL with 403 and leaves the offline index empty.

cache_dir.label: Title Dump Cache Directory
cache_dir.description: Absolute path of the writable directory holding the title-dump index. It MUST live outside the read-only plugin tree and MUST NOT be world-writable (the index is served from it). A relative or non-string value is refused at plugin construction. Leave unset to fall back to the PHLIX_ANIDB_CACHE_DIR environment variable, then sys_get_temp_dir()/phlix-plugin-anidb.
